heuristics.name: plausible-headword target
heuristics.description: pick the option that is the most natural synonym target for a harder typical ISEE headword (e.g. postpone<-defer, impede<-hinder, fleeting<-ephemeral)

heuristics.name: odd-one-out register
heuristics.description: pick the option whose register/specificity differs from the other three when no headword stands out

notes: All picks are guesses; no option judged certainly impossible without the stem, so reject_certain is false throughout and reject letters are low-confidence.
